description: This file defines the HyperGeometric class, which calculates hypergeometric distribution probabilities used in statistical computations within a PHP spreadsheet library. It includes a public static method 'distribution' that computes the distribution based on input parameters, supporting array inputs for vectorized calculations.

classes.name: HyperGeometric
classes.description: A class providing static methods to compute hypergeometric distribution probabilities in statistical calculations.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the hypergeometric distribution probability for given sample successes, sample size, population successes, and population size, supporting array inputs for vectorized computation.
